info.name: C17 Task & Document Platform — Full API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the C17 Task & Document Platform.

BASE URL: http://localhost:3000 (API Gateway)
All external requests go through the Gateway with /api/ prefix.

Authentication:
- Login as employee: employee@c17.local / Employee123!
- Login as admin: admin@c17.local / Admin123!
- All authenticated endpoints require Bearer token from login response.

Dynamic Data:
- Timestamps use {{currentTimestamp}} variable (auto-generated).
- UUIDs use pre-request scripts to generate unique IDs.
- Save tokens/IDs via Tests scripts for chaining requests.

Workflow Steps:
1. Authentication — login, get tokens
2. User Management — create users, assign capabilities
3. Task Management — create tasks, lifecycle transitions
4. Document Upload — multipart upload, security pipeline
5. Permission Management — create grants, delegate, revoke
6. Secure Download — ticket creation, redeem, decrypt
7. Audit Log — query events, verify chain
8. Records & Transfer — create records, transfer packages
9. Retention & Disposal — eligibility, holds, disposal
10. Notification — preferences, read notifications
11. Security Monitoring — rules, alerts, session revocation
12. Health & Verification — service health, audit chain verify

item.name: 4. Document Upload
item.description: Upload documents through the secure pipeline. The file goes through Gateway → Document Management → Document Security → ClamAV scan → AES-256-GCM encryption → MinIO storage.

request.description:
Upload a document via multipart form.

The file is:
1. Scanned by ClamAV (real antivirus)
2. Checksummed with SHA-256
3. Encrypted with AES-256-GCM (random DEK, wrapped by KEK)
4. HMAC-signed for tamper detection
5. Stored in MinIO as ciphertext

Select a file in the 'file' field above.

Response: { document: { id, title, ... }, version: { version, file_size, mime_type, signature } }

Note: object_key is EXCLUDED from the public DTO by design.

Upload with declared_state_secret=true.

This should be REJECTED (400) before Document creation.

item.name: 5. Task–Document Sharing
item.description: A Task–Document association is required before any task-scoped Document Grant is valid. Task membership alone never grants Document access. Recommended order: 3.1 → 3.4 → 4.1 → 5.1 → 5.2 → 5.3 → 5.4 → 5.5 → 5.6 → 5.7 → 5.8.

item.name: 5.1 Attach Document and Grant Assignee (PREVIEW + DOWNLOAD)

request.description: Creator attaches the uploaded Document to the assigned Task and creates one explicit task-scoped Grant for the Assignee. The backend validates the Task, direct recipient, Document ownership/share authority, Task–Document association, and expiry. It saves both association and Grant IDs automatically.

exec: console.log('TaskDocument association and Grant IDs saved.');

item.name: 5.2 List Accessible Task Documents as Assignee

request.description: Returns only attached Documents for which the Assignee has a valid PREVIEW Grant scoped to this Task. Direct Task membership alone is not enough.

item.name: 5.3 Get Shared Document Metadata as Assignee

request.description: Document detail succeeds because the Assignee has a valid task-scoped PREVIEW Grant and the association still exists.
Requires DOWNLOAD on the Document. The ticket is bound to this Assignee and checked again at redemption.
Streams plaintext only after ticket, grant, association, signature, and checksum checks pass.

item.name: 5.6 Unrelated Employee Lists Task Documents (Should REJECT)

request.description: An Employee who is not the Creator, current Assignee, or explicit Task Participant must receive 403.

item.name: 5.7 Detach Document and Revoke Task Grants

request.description: Detaches only this Task–Document association and revokes Grants with this task_id. The Document, versions, MinIO object, and Grants belonging to another Task remain intact.
Should return 403 after detach because the task-scoped Grant's association is no longer valid.

item.name: 6. Secure Download
item.description: Download documents via the secure ticket flow: create ticket → redeem ticket → receive decrypted plaintext.

request.description:
Create a time-limited download ticket.

Requires DOWNLOAD permission.
Ticket is single-use, capped at grant.effective_expires_at.

Redeem the download ticket.

Flow:
1. Validates ticket (matches doc, version, actor, not used, not expired)
2. Calls Document Security to retrieve ciphertext from MinIO
3. Unwraps DEK using KEK
4. AES-256-GCM decrypt
5. Verifies SHA-256 checksum
6. Streams plaintext back

Response: application/octet-stream (raw file bytes)

IMPORTANT: The ticket is now USED and cannot be redeemed again.

Attempt to replay a used ticket.

Should return 403 with reason_code: DOWNLOAD_TICKET_ALREADY_USED.
Tickets are single-use by design.

item.name: 8. Records & Transfer Packages
item.description: Manage archival records and transfer packages. Requires ARCHIVE_SUBMIT capability for submission, ARCHIVE_RECEIVE for receiving.

request.description:
Create a new record (EMPLOYEE only, ADMIN denied).

Record starts in DRAFT status.
Add a document version entry to the record.

Seal the record.

No more entries can be added after sealing. This request also requires an ADMIN-created TRANSFER grant scoped to resource_type=RECORD and this record ID; the document grant in 5.1 is not sufficient.

Create a transfer package.

Requires ARCHIVE_SUBMIT capability + a TRANSFER permission grant scoped to this record/package workflow. ADMIN is denied from this operation.

Submit the transfer package.

Status: DRAFT → SUBMITTED.
Requires ARCHIVE_SUBMIT capability and a TRANSFER grant scoped to the package ID.

Receive the transfer package as a separate archivist employee.

Status: SUBMITTED → RECEIVED_CHECKING.
The submitter cannot receive their own package; use {{archivistToken}} for a different EMPLOYEE with ARCHIVE_RECEIVE capability.

Accept the transfer package as the archivist employee.

Status: RECEIVED_CHECKING → ACCEPTED. Requires ARCHIVE_RECEIVE capability.

Archive the transfer package as the archivist employee.

Status: ACCEPTED → ARCHIVED (terminal). Requires ARCHIVE_RECEIVE capability.

Alternative to accept/archive: run this on a fresh RECEIVED_CHECKING package, not after 8.7 or 8.8.

Requires ARCHIVE_RECEIVE capability.
